authority.verification_method: git show commit:path, then normalize LF to CRLF before SHA-256

paper_e.switch_rule: Use ICAART only if Owner authorization before 2026-10-29 AoE, presentation/travel acceptance, school recognition and identity-sensitive fields are all confirmed; otherwise do not submit ICAART and prepare the SNCS package under a separate Owner authorization. Never submit simultaneously.
first_review_required_hardening: label source-table units and clustering explicitly
label FinRank v2 identity results as post-hoc
retain synthetic-corpus, single-judge, neural-baseline and unresolved-reproduction limitations
do not claim universal methods, Agent-system coverage, benchmark failure or acceptance-rate advantage

c1.next_missing_evidence: A truly frozen, causally aligned second dataflow plus independent semantic/harmfulness labels and a natural-defect denominator.

c2.current_result: On 72 frozen outputs, neutral retry has 56 correct with 0 wrong-to-correct and 0 correct-to-wrong; localization has 49 correct, 0 wrong-to-correct and 7 correct-to-wrong; execution has 40 correct, 0 wrong-to-correct and 16 correct-to-wrong.
c2.evidence_identity: Development evidence; later C replay is PRIOR_ERROR_POOL_DEVELOPMENT_REPLAY, not new-family confirmation.
c2.next_missing_evidence: A stable one-shot operator plus source-isolated, teacher/verifier-verified, training-qualified corrections before O/N/R/E.

c3.current_result: Original 60 correct/12 wrong; neutral retry 62/10; semantic gate 32/6 with 34 abstentions and 52.8% coverage; bounded repair 33/6 with 33 abstentions and 54.2% coverage.
c3.cost_boundary: One local run: original 41,997 tokens/51.99s, neutral retry 52,223/94.42s, localization 64,326/173.91s; total three-condition generation 216 attempts and 158,546 tokens. Stable throughput and policy-level marginal cost are unverified.
c3.next_missing_evidence: A preregistered disjoint new-family panel with matched risk-coverage, marginal token/GPU/tool/wall cost and non-abstention action utility.
